User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the TronPay Gateway.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user (matches Firebase Auth UID).

username.description: The username or display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

registrationDate.description: The date and time the user registered.

UserWallet.title: UserWallet
UserWallet.description: Represents a user's wallet for various currencies.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this wallet.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the wallet.

walletAddress.description: The public address of the wallet.

privateKeyEncrypted.description: Encrypted private key for the wallet. Placeholder for simulation.

balance.description: The current balance of the wallet.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the wallet was created.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a transaction within the TronPay Gateway.

initiatorUserId.description: The user who initiated this transaction.

senderWalletId.description: The sender's identifier, which can be a wallet address, IP address, or 'Credit/Debit Card'.

receiverWalletId.description: The recipient's wallet address or account identifier.

transactionHash.description: The transaction hash on the blockchain (mocked for now).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the transaction occurred.

status.description: The status of the transaction (e.g., pending, confirmed, failed).

memo.description: An optional memo for the transaction.

type.description: The type of transaction (p2p, card, ip).

serverDetails.description: Technical details for Advanced IP Transfers.

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: Represents a user's linked bank account.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this account.

routingNumber.description: Routing number (should be encrypted in a real app).

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment
RiskAssessment.description: Represents the risk assessment of a transaction.

transactionId.description: Reference to the Transaction being assessed.

riskScore.description: A numerical score indicating the risk level (0-100).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public user profile data. The document ID is the Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/wallets/{walletId}.description: Subcollection for a user's wallets. Path-based ownership simplifies security.

/users/{userId}/bankAccounts/{accountId}.description: Subcollection for a user's linked bank accounts.

/users/{userId}/all_transactions/{transa.description: Subcollection for ALL of a user's initiated transactions.

/risk_assessments/{assessmentId}.description: Top-level collection for storing AI risk assessment results.
